arling-sans-400.ttf, arling-sans-600.ttf

Schibsted Grotesk (c) Schibsted Media Group, SIL Open Font License 1.1
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/schibstedgrotesk
Full license text: https://openfontlicense.org/

These files are static instances (weight 400 and 600) of the ARLing Sans subset
from ops/design/paper/fonts/arling-sans.woff2 (Latin, Latin-1, Latin Extended-A,
general punctuation and currency), converted to TTF with fontTools on 30 Sep 2026
so that the browser can embed them into the Rukopis PDF report.

jspdf.umd.min.js: jsPDF 4.2.1, MIT license, see LICENSE-jspdf.txt.
Source: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF (npm package "jspdf" 4.2.1).
The only change is the removed sourceMappingURL comment on the last line.
